title: Introducing an Abusive Language Classification Framework for Telegram to Investigate the German Hater Community
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development and evaluation of a classification framework for detecting abusive language and hate speech on Telegram. While the topics include identity-based hate (e.g., Islamophobia and Antisemitism), the work is an NLP safety classification task rather than a benchmarking of religion, faith, or moral/ethical reasoning.
